THE SHEEN IS COMING FROM AN ON-SITE CATCH BASIN AND STORM WATER PIPING THAT APPEARS TO HAVE HAD A SMALL AMOUNT OF RESIDUAL DIESEL FROM A SMALL SPILL ON-SITE LAST NIGHT.
